The call to tvb_captured_length() will prevent the heuristic isector to be called with a shortened capture with a snaplen. Is this on purpose?

The original heuristic was only checking the min and max lengths for RF4CE packets, I decided to keep that and add more checks. I did not test it with shortened capture. Also, I am not aware of any need to shortened capture for RF4CE, since it is usually formed by small packets. Is there a use case I should be aware of?
If that is needed for all dissectors regardless of their usual packet sizes, I can just remove this check for length.

You should let this check. I'm just surprised that you are using tvb_captured_length instead of tvb_reported_length as a user might have configured tcpdump/dumpcap to capture only the first X bytes of each packet (what is called snaplen).
@pquantin , you are right, I should have used `tvb_reported_length` - I will fix that
The tvb_captured_length() check is still required though as soon as you use a tvb_get_XXX function during the heuristic check (as indicated in my other comments).
Done.
